# **The Problem**

* Content doesn’t convert  
* No time  
* Inconsistent lead flow  
* Confused about ad structure  
* No system

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

“Good marketers ***find*** their ideal customers.   
Great marketers ***create*** their ideal customers.”

**\- Dan Henry \-** 

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Which brings me to… Vaccines…**

In order to get people to rush to take a vaccine, you don’t sell a *vaccine*. Nobody would want that. 

What you do is sell *this belief system*: 

* **Core belief:** there’s a big scary virus  
* **The real problem:** you can’t fight it naturally so you need a vaccine  
* **Time:** If you don’t take it now, you’ll not only die, you’ll kill others. Here’s ‘evidence’  
* **Money:** It’s free  
* **Method:** It’s easy, just drive up and get jabbed  
* **Help:** We’ll do it for you because we’re trained medical professionals  
* **Identity:** “I’m Vaxxed” (anti-vaxxer)

**The Truth is:** The only way to get people to engage with your content and buy your stuff is by getting them to believe what you need them to believe and assume an identity. You’re not selling a product or service, you’re selling a belief system and an identity system.

Steve Jobs transformed Apple. Not because he had better technology, but he sold the belief system of thinking differently, being an innovator, being ahead of the curve, and he sold that belief system. Once you believed those things, you bought apple products

You already do this with your kids. To get them to eat their food, you tell them there’s starving kids in India. They believe it. They feel guilty for not eating. So they eat. Now we need to do it deliberately in your business so your prospects want to buy.

In this workshop, I’m going to share with you the 2 identities you need to define and the 6 beliefs you need to shift to make selling your programs way easier.

## **Definitions**

**Prop·a·gan·da:** 

'Information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view.'

In simple terms

**Propaganda is systematic persuasion designed to shift beliefs and shape behavior.**

Propaganda is just a tool.

A hammer can build a house or bash someone's skull in.

The tool isn't evil. The person using it determines the outcome.

**Today, you're going to learn how to use this tool ethically to help people who need your help.**

Because right now, the coaches with worse results than you are getting MORE clients...

...simply because they're better at systematic persuasion.

And that's not fair to the people who should be buying from YOU."

### **What We're Actually Talking About**

"So when I say 'Propaganda Machine,' what I really mean is:

**A systematic content and retargeting system that shifts beliefs so prospects close themselves.**

Just a framework for getting people to believe what they need to believe to make the right decision.

Sound good?

Cool. Let's build your machine.

# **The ‘Core 6’ Beliefs**  {#the-‘core-6’-beliefs}

Every prospect needs to shift 6 beliefs before they'll buy. Fill out what YOUR prospects currently believe vs. what they NEED to believe:

### **Framework**

| Old Belief What do they believe now? |  | New Belief What belief do they need to buy? |
| :---: | ----- | :---: |
| The fastest way to **(BIG GOAL)** is by **(OLD METHOD)** | **1** Core Belief | The fastest way to **(BIG GOAL)** is to **(NEW METHOD)**.  |
| The problem is **(WHAT THEY THINK IT IS)** | **2** Real Problem | The real problem is **(REAL PROBLEM)** |
| My priority is **(CURRENT METHOD)** | **3** Time | **(NEW METHOD)** is the most important thing to spend time on right now. |
| My money is best spent on **other things** | **4** Money | My money is best spent on **(NEW METHOD)** |
| **(CURRENT/OLD METHOD)** are the best way to get **(BIG GOAL)** | **5** Method | **(NEW METHOD)** is the best and only permanent way to **(BIG GOAL)** |
| Doing this on my own through trial & error is the best path to **(BIG GOAL)** | **6** Help | Getting help and following a proven strategy is the best path to **(BIG GOAL)** |

### **Example**

Replace the grey boxes for your business

| Old Belief What do they believe now? |  | New Belief What belief do they need to buy? |
| :---: | ----- | :---: |
| The fastest way to **Get to 7 Figures** is by **Getting MORE Leads, Clients & Team** | **1** Core Belief | The fastest way to **7 Figure Freedom** is to **become data-driven** |
| The problem is **lack of leads** | **2** Real Problem | The real problem is **you don’t know where you’re going, not tracking, making emotional decisions** |
| My priority is **getting more leads, hiring team members, working harder** | **3** Time | **Reverse engineering your path to freedom with data** is the most important thing to spend time on right now. |
| My money is best spent on **more tactics, strategies & a team of experts to do the job for me** | **4** Money | My money is best spent on **systems & advisors who can help me get clear, organized and scale sustainably** |
| **More leads, clients & team** are the best way to get **to $100k/m** | **5** Method | **Being data-driven** is the best and only permanent way to **7 Figure Freedom** |
| Doing this on my own through trial & error is the best path to **7 Figure Freedom** | **6** Help | Getting help and following a proven system is the best path to **7 Figure Freedom** |
